assumptions.description: Transport source component associations from US, Finland and Iran to the specified Mexico equal-cell design is unverified, including country, age ranges and composition. Repeated sources/seeds do not supply independent evidence.
Bridge plasma/serum, HbA1c assay differences and unverified preanalytical differences as sufficiently comparable for chosen parameters; this is not an established measurement conversion.

Source fasting, diabetes, HbA1c, medication and complete-case restrictions differ; use the chosen law for the already-selected task population without asserting verified anemia or medication exclusions.

Using weighted or incompletely described source estimands in an equal-cell law assumes portability; it does not make an unweighted operator an estimator of the same source quantity. Unknown weighting remains unknown.

Finnish binary-age and fasting-duration adjustment differ from H02 continuous age and absent duration. Their transfer and omission of interactions are unverified. A common linear conditional mean is assumed.

Finnish S1 response units are inferred as mmol/L and S2 as HbA1c percentage points from main-text/numerical context, not printed supplement headers. Convert glucose by18 mg/dL per mmol/L. Reported raw coefficients, this interpretation and derived spec values remain distinct. Requested age10/bmi5 coefficients multiply raw-scale effects by10/5.

Assume Kerman marginal r*SD(H)/SD(G) may serve as a target conditional glucose coefficient after age, sex and BMI adjustment; source moments identify only the marginal projection. Printed Table2 slopes are rejected, not corrected.

Assume cross-source linear mean coherence for the omitted-variable BMI/sex decompositions; reduced effect=conditional effect plus glucose coefficient times glucose-covariate effect. Q3 is not directly reported or causal.
Task requires exactly375 per female0/1 by four stated age bands; within-band discrete uniform ages and deterministic unique IDs are construction assumptions, not national sampling.
BMI=14+42*Beta(4,8), independent of age and female, is an unverified bounded right-skewed law with rounded mean28 and SD5.49125. Neither the family, support nor independence is source-estimated.

For the selected cohort, glucose conditional beta support55 to126 and precision8.5 are assumed. This gives a mean-preserving bounded law and heteroscedastic variance; 12.4 is a Kerman marginal SD, not a target conditional SD.
Divide Finnish older-minus-younger glucose contrast by midpoint gap17.5 years and extrapolate the continuous linear slope through ages25-79; source binary contrast does not identify this gradient.

Use chosen rounded glucose baseline94 and HbA1c5.45 at age50, male and BMI28. Finnish displayed intercepts contextualize but do not identify these target locations; fasting-time reference is unavailable.

Independent standardized Beta(3,3) HbA1c innovation with conditional SD0.40 is assumed; symmetry, bounded tails and homoscedasticity are not estimated by source marginal SDs or SEs. No HbA1c diagnostic cutoff is imposed.

All variables have bounded support and finite moments; resulting population projection identities follow from the proposed law, not target evidence. Numerical glucose endpoint protection only guards rounding to126.
No probability model for parameter, source or transport uncertainty is supplied. Individual residuals and repeated seeds do not estimate such uncertainty.
